description: THE TASK of a reel set for Listing 7 (misty balloons, neutral audience, owner 08.11), BRIGHTER designs (the first round was all beige): s1 = a boy of about four in a Retro Kids room with mustard accents looks up and points at the big balloon (calm gesture, Grok / Kling); s2 = the same wall in a Fun Haus room (brick-red striped cushion on a cream arch bench) at golden hour, no person, a slow walk-in with parallax (Kling). Clean rooms: no basket / wicker / rattan, nothing draped, a blanket only folded neatly. py -3.12 -X utf8 scripts/director.py plan l7_reel01

slots.motion_extra: Soft dappled shadows of leafy branches sway slowly on the wall and on the floor, as in a light breeze: only the shadows move, subtly and low in contrast, and they never change the colours or the drawing of the mural.
slots.motion_override: A smooth, steady first-person walk-in at a clearly visible calm walking pace: the camera moves forward about one and a half metres into the room at natural eye level and drifts a little to the right as it goes, with no tilt and no rotation, giving a strong soft depth parallax (the nearer objects shift clearly more than the farther ones). The sheer cream curtain in the extreme foreground on the {door_side} leaves the frame as the camera advances past it.
